verification_candidates.claim_text: Most magnesium supplements on the market either underdose magnesium or add unnecessary filler ingredients.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: most of the stuff on the shelf either underdoses the magnesium or loads it with a bunch of filler i don't care about
verification_candidates.rationale: Comparative claim about typical magnesium supplement formulation is checkable against product labels.

verification_candidates.claim_text: In supplements with many listed ingredients, some ingredients are probably included at doses too small to have an effect.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: half of it is probably in there at doses too small to matter anyway
verification_candidates.rationale: Claim about sub-therapeutic dosing in multi-ingredient supplements is checkable against formulation data.
